title: Eugenicist elites become the Nordics

tellings.quote: and that's that these elites become the Nordics

plain: The eugenics-minded elites of the US, Britain and Germany between about 1890 and 1939 are said to "become the Nordics," the tall, fair, human-looking beings that some alien contact stories describe. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani makes this argument on the show, naming the birth-control campaigner Margaret Sanger among those elites and drawing on a work called Closer Encounters. His point is that the Nordic beings of these stories would mirror that era's ideal of a superior race.
